content.title: 2026 Masters: How to watch the golf tournament with DIRECTV, full TV schedule, tee times and more
content.text: The 2026 Masters golf tournament is this week, and some of the biggest names in the sport are ready to hit the green, including 2025 winner Rory McIlroy and 2024 champ Scottie Scheffler. — Tiger Woods and Phil Mickelson will not be playing this year.Coverage of the first major golf tournament of the year will be spread across multiple channels and platforms The first two days of the tournament will be available on CBS Sports Network, Paramount+, ESPN, and Prime Video. Saturday and Sunday coverage will air on CBS and stream on Paramount+ and ESPN+. Here's how to stream the tournament (mostly) all in one place with DIRECTV, plus what you need to know about this week's schedule, tee times, and more.AdvertisementDates: April 9-12TV channel: CBS, CBS Sports Network, ESPNStreaming: DIRECTV MySports® Genre Pack®When is the 2026 Masters?The 2026 Masters golf tournament runs from April 9-12, 2026.What channel is the Masters on?Daily coverage of the Masters will be broadcast on ESPN and CBS Sports Network on April 9 and 10, and on CBS on Saturday and Sunday. There will also be daily coverage streaming on Paramount+, and daily highlights from the first two rounds on Amazon's Prime Video.If you're looking for just one service to carry you through the 2026 Masters gold tournament, we recommend the DIRECTV MySports® Genre Pack®, which offers access to local CBS, CBS Sports Network, and ESPN Unlimited.
